rationale: The Pages workflow is byte-identical to the accepted EMC release base. The original retained-source proof, original predecessor commit, exact ordinary source-delta checks, exact generated bytes, accepted existing registry ordering, artifact and receipt pins, unchanged predecessor builders, and repeat checks before and after packaging all remain mandatory.

The only permitted additional compiled namespace files are the ten exact isolated weighted-history inputs below, disjoint from the predecessor namespace. The only new registry exception is one byte-equivalent structured entry from the validated exact E5 approval; the preexisting EMC exception is unchanged. The standard builder adds the clay bundle and model package replay without removing any existing checks.

The reviewed main-workspace controller SHA-256 d0cfa06dd89152db25a97e28daa7769d4f21b95d50f6cf918d708a9e22afe989 was reconstructed byte for byte from the release baseline and pinned patch in a disposable overlay. The ordinary recorded controller remains identical to the accepted base; only the isolated profile selects the generated overlay header.

A fresh minimal source tree populated from the original predecessor Git blobs passed the direct source and fresh generated-byte checks for HvWE (320 source bindings), Maxwell (302) and controlled time (299). Independent negative checks rejected an unknown additional source, an altered reviewed source digest, and the wrong exact approval. No compiled target, full package, browser, or deployment was run by this reviewer.
